interpretation_note: Experimental causal screen only. Authoritative partial-exact collection, deck schedule, Advantage fit gate and live primary batch RNG are preserved. Surrogate training uses an isolated side RNG and therefore does not consume the primary stream. The candidate changes only next-iteration behavior to a smooth policy network trained on sample-level regret-matched Advantage targets. Because regret matching is nonlinear, this is not claimed equivalent to Deep CFR and cannot be promoted without a separate algorithm/versioning review.
